description: Get a fix for a described UX issue: detects the most likely smell (or uses the one you pass), then returns its step-by-step fix recipe, the principles to apply and a refactoring prompt you can hand to a coding agent. Use it when you want an actionable remedy rather than a diagnosis; runs offline.

issue.description: The UX issue to fix, in plain language (e.g., "the checkout asks for account creation before showing the price").

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

smell_id.description: Optional smell id to skip detection when the smell is already known (e.g., "dead-end-states").

name: suggest_fix
title: Suggest a fix for a UX issue
